# HEARTz

> A browser-based workspace for exploring sound, creating frequencies and retuning supported audio.

HEARTz has a public introduction at https://heartz.app/ and an account-based application at https://app.heartz.app/. The application offers guided soundscapes, a frequency lab, a 440-to-432 Hz converter and a personal library of saved settings.

## Explore

- [Try audio samples](https://heartz.app/#demo-player) on the public landing page.
- [Create an account](https://app.heartz.app/signup) to use the application.
- [Open the converter](https://app.heartz.app/converter) to retune a supported audio file and download a WAV result.
- [Open Frequency Lab](https://app.heartz.app/frequency-lab) to configure tones and binaural differences.
- [Browse guided sessions](https://app.heartz.app/guided) for ready-made soundscapes.
- [Open My library](https://app.heartz.app/library) to return to saved settings.

## Data and availability

Audio processing takes place on the user's device. Account sign-in uses Firebase Authentication. Saved settings are stored in the current browser for the signed-in account; they do not yet sync across devices. Source music files and rendered audio are not stored in the account library.

For further detail, see [the HEARTz product reference](https://heartz.app/llms-full.txt).
